name: DATAPRP
recent: Dataprep 近期高层人事变动频繁，包括执行主席、执行董事及首席财务官相继辞职，并于11月20日委任 Datuk Wira Shamshuri 为新任主席。公司同时推进最多占已发行股本10%的私募配售，已获 Bursa Securities 批准上市最多94,209,000股新股。此外，公司更改财政年度结束日。
notable: 委任 Datuk Wira Shamshuri bin Abdul Majid 为董事会主席。
执行主席 Dr Wan Ahmad Rudirman、执行董事 Datuk Syahril Yusri 及首席财务官 Puan Razina 相继辞职。
最多发行占已发行股本10%的新股，已获 Bursa Securities 批准上市最多94,209,000股。
risks: 私募配售最多发行10%新股，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
多名高层包括执行主席、执行董事及首席财务官在短期内相继辞职。
大股东 Datuk Wira Shamshuri 在10月出售1800万股后，于11月增持1900万股，股权出现变动。
earnings: 最近一期财报（截至2025年3月31日）营收为983,000令吉，净亏损3,950,000令吉，净亏损率为401.8%。

events.what_en: Listing approval for up to 94,209,000 placement shares

recent_en: Dataprep has seen frequent senior management changes recently, including the resignations of its Executive Chairman, Executive Director and CFO, and appointed Datuk Wira Shamshuri as new Chairman on 20 November. The company is also undertaking a private placement of up to 10% of its issued shares, with Bursa Securities approving the listing of up to 94,209,000 new shares. It also changed its financial year end.
notable_en: Appointed Datuk Wira Shamshuri bin Abdul Majid as Chairman of the Board.
Executive Chairman Dr Wan Ahmad Rudirman, Executive Director Datuk Syahril Yusri and CFO Puan Razina resigned.
Proposed private placement of up to 10% of issued shares; Bursa Securities approved listing of up to 94,209,000 new shares.
risks_en: Private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
Several senior executives, including the Executive Chairman, Executive Director and CFO, resigned within a short period.
Major shareholder Datuk Wira Shamshuri disposed 18 million shares in October and acquired 19 million shares in November, resulting in shareholding changes.
earnings_en: For the latest financial period ended 31 March 2025, revenue was MYR983,000 and net loss was MYR3,950,000, with a net loss margin of 401.8%.
